approved: Private Health Insurance Amendment (Modernising the Private Health Insurance Rebate) Bill 2026

Moved the second reading of a bill removing higher private health insurance rebates for people aged 65 and over from 1 April 2027 while retaining means testing and other supports. Argued the change would restore intergenerational equity and redirect an estimated $3 billion in savings to additional aged-care beds, packages, shorter waits and improved care.

Presented the Selection of Bills Committee's seventh report and moved its adoption; the report recommended immediate referral of four bills concerning defence, health insurance and tax reform to Senate committees with reporting dates from 13 August to 7 October 2026, while an amendment proposed referring a workplace relations bill by 10 August.
